race.comment: INTELLECTUAL (2) is a promising gelding resuming for the sharp R & C Jolly camp. Has made a bright start to his career and jumped fav over what looks a pretty handy one in Mathematician back in Feb. Was gapped there but looks to have gone amiss and been spelled. Has trialled up a treat and is the one to beat. UP THE DEN (1) also resumes and is another that has trialled strongly in readiness. Boasts a strong record and should land in the perfect spot from his draw. Is sure to be right there when they quicken. ZOUTRAIL (8) has been knocking on the door for a while but continues to find a few better. Gets in at featherweight and is drawn cosy. Have to include. STAND ALONE (3) was ridden quieter here and finished off well to reel them in and score. Tougher now but is in the mix. SCOOPED (7) has good early toe and should be at his top fourth-up. Including.
